rule: No process-global mutable state in gwz-transport, which gwz-core's transport build links into every per-operation runtime of a core session (GwzCoreSessionDesign O9). gwz-core keeps this list because it is the consumer: gwz-transport depends on nothing, carries no gwz-core tooling and runs no O9 gate in its own CI. scripts/run_tests.py checks the gwz-transport checkout that GWZ_TRANSPORT_CHECKOUT names, or else the one beside gwz-core, which tests/transport_backend/prepare.py builds against; with neither it fails, unless a CI job with no gwz-transport checkout passes --skip-transport-globals. gwz-core's boundary CI job checks gwz-transport at reconciled_commit, the commit these entries were last reconciled against, which must already be on gwz-transport's GitHub main. Bump rule: a gwz-core commit that changes this list sets reconciled_commit in the same commit, to a gwz-transport commit that is already pushed; upstream goes first (GwzCoreSessionDesign §5.7). This list is the complete inventory of production exceptions. check_process_globals.py fails on anything unlisted and on entries that no longer match, so the list only shrinks.
